reviews.title: Great Aio!
reviews.comment: Excellent cooler for the price. Does the job very well and looks great. Easy installation and software to control the screen. Will definitely use again in future builds.
reviews.author: Stevo

reviews.title: Good Well Priced AIO
reviews.comment: So far so good. Other names like Corsair basically rip you off for higher priced AIO’s. I went from a Be Quiet Elite Air cooler to this and it’s working well so far. I’ll update if it breaks at any point within the year. But so far its cooling my Ryzen 7 7800X3D just fine and keeping temps around 60C.
reviews.author: Ronaldo J.

reviews.title: Excellent AIO
reviews.comment: Looks very good easy installe clear clean installations using SignalRGB to control the screen and led and it works great! Thanks!!
